title: Unit Event — Popping in My Heart! — Episode3 The Most Incredible Show

meta.Event Outline: Emu takes part in a discussion with her brothers regarding future operations of the park. However, each idea she puts forth comes up against issues of feasibility, leaving her determined to educate herself. That's when she gets the news of an opportunity to visit Mr. Riley's park...

rows.Line: Riley Dream Park

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (Alright, I'm gonna learn as much as I can today! In the name of all that's wonderhoy!)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (Also, based on what Keisuke and Shosuke told me, I know about how much it costs to run each area with our current cast...)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (First, I'll need to see what separates our park from Mr. Riley's!)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hmm... The show stage is supposed to be somewhere around here...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I'm still amazed at how this area's been designed. It's like we're in a real medieval castle town...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: This being the area for “The Little Kingdom”, they must've gone through quite a bit of trouble to recreate the movie's medieval fantasy setting.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Riley Dream Park's designed to let its visitors experience in real life what they see in Riley Entertainment's feature films.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Nowadays, parks like these are fairly commonplace, but this park remains a cut above the rest of them.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: And seeing how each area is based on a different story's so much fun!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Oh, speaking of which...!
Mr. Riley and my brothers are gone, so they can come out now, right?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: The coast is clear, Miku!

rows.Speaker: Miku's Voice
rows.Line: <Okay!!>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
<Ask and you shall receive!
Here's Miku☆>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <I wanna do that too♪ Here's Rin♪>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Oh, me too! Here's Len♪>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
<Look at that.
Like three peas in a pod.>

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
<Hahaha!
Or more like a sardine can!>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
<Thank you for remembering, Emu.
Are you all about to head over to see a show?>

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Yup!
We're gonna go catch “The Little Kingdom”!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: It'll probably be dark inside the theatre, so we may want to sit somewhere towards the back. That way, you and the others should also be able to see the show, Miku.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
<We really appreciate it.
All of you, please make sure to behave.>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Okay!>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <We will☆>

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <Hehe. You sounded like a school teacher just now, KAITO.>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
<Huh?
Haha. I guess I did, huh?>

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Aha, there it is!
That looks like the show stage!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Alright, it's showtime!
Everyone ready?!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Yeah☆>
“The Little Kingdom” Stage

rows.Speaker: King
rows.Line: 『Come on, stab me in the heart!』

rows.Speaker: Prince
rows.Line: 『Dad...Please don't make me do this!』
se_event_nikkori_2022_005

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (Whoa!!)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
(How'd they pull that off?!
The wall run they did was amazing too... This might be better than the movie!)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Ah, I see. It's a fairly simple wire stunt, but they've polished quite a bit. I almost thought they actually flew there for a second...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (However, what's most staggering is...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (Their sheer acting ability...!)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (I'd seen videos of performances from abroad, but seeing one in real life is something else entirely...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (From the way they project their voices to even the subtlest actions... It's pure perfection. This must be the true definition of “being in character”.)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (I can't look away. I feel compelled to keep watching...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: So this is a world-class cast...

rows.Speaker: PlaceInfo
rows.Line: Riley Dream Park

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Wow...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Hey, Emu... Emu!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Huh?
What?! Is it over?!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah, are you back from whatever trance you were in? I mean, I get how you feel. It was a pretty amazing show.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. Captivating and compelling to say the least.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Yeah!
It was extra exciting and super spectacular!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (Wait, no...! I'm here to learn, not play around!)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I think I counted twenty cast members, and the theatre had a capacity of...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <Tsukasa.>

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hm? Yes, KAITO...?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
<Is everything okay?
You seemed concerned there for a second.>

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes, there is something on my mind...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <May I ask what?>

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
It's about...
...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <I wouldn't worry too much, Tsukasa.>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <For your dream's sake, I say just take it one step at a time.>

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Heh. Saw right through me, did you? Nicely done.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: But you're right. After all, I'm a future star...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Be it little by little, I'll be making progress toward my ultimate goal!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
That was a spectacular show!
It made me want to grow and hone my craft even more as an actor!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Ah, that show must've had quite an impact on you. Of course, it had a similar effect on me as well.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Wonderful!
Let's keep that feeling in mind and move to the next area! We should be able to see another show there, yes?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yup! Let's go go go!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Hmm... Looks like we'll have to wait a bit until the shows for the other areas start.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <I know! Let's go on some rides while we wait!>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
<Oh, that sounds like fun♪
I'm all for that.>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Are you sure about this? Aren't you guys supposed to learn as much as you can about this park?>

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, I see no problem with that.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Mr. Riley even suggested that we experience the park in several different ways, which leads to me believe that he wants us to see more than just shows.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Yeah!
We can learn a lot from all these rides and attractions!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Alright, which should we go on first?
The map here says the “Jungle Music” and “Blue World” areas are the closest.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Hmm... Which one...?
Hm...?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <Was that...?>

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <Do you hear it too?>

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Huh?
Hear what?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <It was faint, but I could've sworn that I just heard a child crying somewhere...>

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Yeah, I heard it too...!
I think it was a little girl!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: What crying? I'm not hearing anything...!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Me neither.
However, Emu has better eyes and ears than most.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Taken out of context, it sounds like you're describing a wild animal...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <But if there really is a little girl crying somewhere, we need to help her!>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Yeah!>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <Hehe. I agree completely.>

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes, as do I. Who would we be if we weren't to lend a helping hand to a child in distress?!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Alright, which direction was it?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I think... That way!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <Yes, that sounds right! Let's go!>
